rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for mental focus or concentration.

example.english: My attention is very focused when I read.
example.traditional: 我睇書嗰陣，注意力好集中。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tai2 syu1 go2 zan6 zyu3 ji3 lik6 hou2 zaap6 zung1

rows.note: Use this for attention shown as concern or care for someone, rather than romantic pursuit.

example.english: Thanks for showing me so much attention.
example.jyutping: do1 ze6 nei5 gam3 gwaan1 sam1 ngo5

rows.note: Use this for the romantic slice of someone's attentions, meaning courtship or pursuit.

example.english: They pursued me for a month, and I quite enjoyed the attention.
example.traditional: 佢追求咗我成個月，我幾享受佢嘅注意。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zeoi1 kau4 zo2 ngo5 seng4 go3 jyut6 ngo5 gei2 hoeng2 sau6 keoi5 ge3 zyu3 ji3
